name: S-Class Bloodstalker
body:
What Are S-Class Characters?

S-class characters are built using the summoner class, as originally presented, as the basis against which all other classes are balanced. The “S” in this case stands for both summoner and, as a more appropriate in-world reference, superior. If you have played—or GM’d for—a summoner and felt it was fine as is, you should have no problem running with an s-class character.

S-class bloodstalkers are specialists in the art of tracking and defeating the creatures that keep villagers hidden away in their homes at night. Twisted nightmare beings, werewolves, flesh golems, and vampires; none are safe from a well prepared s-class bloodstalker.

Alignment: Any non-good.

Hit Die: d10.

Starting Wealth: 4d6 × 10 gp (average 107 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The s-class bloodstalker’s Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana), Perception (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the s-class bloodstalker.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

An s-class bloodstalker is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields (but not tower shields).

Stalker’s Draught (Ex)

Every bloodstalker enters into his order with a special ritual wherein he imbibes a tincture of concentrated evil. At the ritual’s end, the bloodstalker’s alignment is unchanged, but his connection to the magic of death and fury is burned into his soul.

At 1st level, the stalker’s draught grants an s-class bloodstalker a +2 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls This bonus increases by +1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +7 at 20th level. This bonus damage is multiplied on a critical hit.

In addition, the bloodstalker chooses three creature types from among those listed here. aberrations, evil outsiders, fey, monstrous humanoids, undead.

He gains a bonus equal to half his bloodstalker level on Survival checks made to track creatures of those types.

He may make Knowledge skill checks untrained when attempting to identify those creatures.

Deadly Stalker

At 2nd level, an s-class bloodstalker deals +1d6 additional damage with attacks made against creatures with any of his chosen types. This damage is considered precision damage that overcomes any immunity those creatures may have to precision damage, but doesn’t multiply on a critical hit. It increases by +1d6 at 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

Uncanny Dodge

At 4th level, an s-class bloodstalker gains uncanny dodge, as the rogue feature, when fighting against creatures of his chosen types This becomes improved uncanny dodge at 8th level.

Sanguine Ritual (Su)

At 1st level, an s-class bloodstalker can spend 1 minute drawing on the memory of the pain he suffered after drinking the bloodstalker’s draught to imbue one or more of the weapons he wields. This reduces the bloodstalker’s maximum hit points by his bloodstalker level—dealing that much damage to him—and adds the damage listed on Table: Bloodstalker to his successful attacks. The type of damage is determined at the end of the ritual and cannot be changed until the next time the bloodstalker uses sanguine ritual. This damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.

Detect Affliction (Su)

At 2nd level, an s-class bloodstalker can detect afflictions at will, which functions as the detect poison spell except that he can detect any affliction. An s-class bloodstalker can, as a move action, concentrate on a single item or individual within 60 feet and determine if it suffers from or can cause an affliction (a poisoned chest, a cursed cloak, and so on). He learns the details of the affliction as if having succeeded at the DC 20 Wisdom check. While focusing on one individual or object, the bloodstalker does not detect afflictions in any other object or individual within range.

Fear No Evil (Ex)

At 2nd level, an s-class bloodstalker’s experience with evil makes him immune to fear (magical or otherwise). Each ally within 10 feet of him gains a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects. This ability functions only while the bloodstalker is conscious, not if he is unconscious or dead.

Bloodstalker Order

At 3rd level, an s-class bloodstalker is no longer a mere recruit, he has become a full-fledged member of his order. Each order grants the bloodstalker special features at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level. A full list of orders can be found at the end of this section, but they include:

Ghost Slayers: An ancient sect of s-class bloodstalkers who seek to end undeath in all of its forms.
Moonguard: Lycanthropy can be cured in those willing to suffer the change back, but for the irredeemable, the moonguard comes.
Outer Realm: Aberrant, alien creatures hunt unsuspecting victims in remote regions of the world, and the bloodstalkers of the bloodstalkers of the outer realm are there to fight them back through tears in reality to whence they came.
Perfected: The perfected seek to push their bodies to the extremes of physical capability through augmentation and experimentation.
Cruelty (Su)

At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, an s-class bloodstalker can select one cruelty. Each cruelty adds an effect to the bloodstalker’s sanguine ritual ability. Whenever the bloodstalker deals his sanguine ritual damage to one target, the target also receives the additional effect from one of the cruelties possessed by the bloodstalker. This choice is made when the attack is made. The target receives a Fortitude save to avoid this cruelty. If the save is successful, the target takes the damage as normal, but not the effects of the cruelty. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the bloodstalker’s level + the bloodstalker’s Wisdom modifier.

At 3rd level, the bloodstalker can select from the following initial cruelties.

Fatigued: The target is fatigued.
Shaken: The target is shaken for 1 round per level of the bloodstalker.
Sickened: The target is sickened for 1 round per level of the bloodstalker.

At 6th level, an s-class bloodstalker adds the following cruelties to the list of those that can be selected.

Dazed: The target is dazed for 1 round.
Diseased: The target contracts a disease, as if the bloodstalker had cast contagion, using his bloodstalker level as his caster level.
Staggered: The target is staggered for 1 round per two levels of the bloodstalker.

At 9th level, an s-class bloodstalker adds the following cruelties to the list of those that can be selected.

Cursed: The target is cursed, as if the bloodstalker had cast bestow curse, using his bloodstalker level as his caster level.
Exhausted: The target is exhausted. The bloodstalker must have the fatigue cruelty before selecting this cruelty.
Frightened: The target is frightened for 1 round per two levels of the bloodstalker. The bloodstalker must have the shaken cruelty before selecting this cruelty.
Nauseated: The target is nauseated for 1 round per three levels of the bloodstalker. The bloodstalker must have the sickened cruelty before selecting this cruelty.
Poisoned: The target is poisoned, as if the bloodstalker had cast poison, using the bloodstalker’s level as the caster level. At 12th level, an s-class bloodstalker adds the following cruelties to the list of those that can be selected.
Blinded: The target is blinded for 1 round per level of the bloodstalker.
Deafened: The target is deafened for 1 round per level of the bloodstalker.
Paralyzed: The target is paralyzed for 1 round.
Stunned: The target is stunned for 1 round per four levels of the bloodstalker.

The bloodstalker can apply cruelties to his charnel touch a number of times per day equal to 1/2 his bloodstalker level + his Charisma modifier. These abilities are not cumulative.

For example, a 14th-level bloodstalker’s charnel touch ability deals 2d8+7 points of damage and might also cause the target to become fatigued, dazed, poisoned, or diseased.

Once a cruelty is chosen, it can’t be changed.

Embrace of Night (Su)

At 5th level, an s-class bloodstalker learns how to blend into and see beyond shadows. He gains darkvision out to 60 feet, or increases his darkvision by 60 feet. In addition, the bloodstalker increases his movement speed by 10 feet at 5th, 8th, 11th, 14th, and 17th level, but the bloodstalker treats spaces with bright light as difficult terrain for this increased speed.

Sanguine Skill (Ex)

Also at 5th level, when he uses his sanguine ritual, an s-class bloodstalker gains a morale bonus on all skill checks with two of the following skills of his choice equal to half his bloodstalker level until he rests for at least 8 hours, or until he uses that ritual again. He can select two additional skills to which he gains this bonus at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

Acrobatics, Climb, Intimidate, Perception, Ride, Sense Motive, Stealth, Swim

Aggravate Affliction (Sp)

At 10th level, an s-class bloodstalker can cast aggravate affliction on a creature within close range (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 levels) a number of times per day equal to his Wisdom modifier. A creature’s spell resistance applies normally to this effect.

All recurring afflictions (those with a frequency, including curses, diseases, and poison) possessed by a creature targeted with aggravate affliction immediately trigger, requiring an immediate saving throw (as described in the affliction) to avoid suffering their effects. A successful saving throw does not count toward ending the affliction, and this extra save does not change the timing of the next save against the affliction. Afflictions without a frequency are unaffected by this ability.

Improved Sanguine Ritual (Su)

At 12th level, an s-class bloodstalker can use sanguine ritual as a swift action.

Esoteric Ritual (Su)

At 13th level, when performing his sanguine ritual, an s-class bloodstalker also adds one or more magic weapon special abilities to his weapon. The total value of these special abilities can be no more than +2, and the weapon must have at least a +1 enhancement bonus to begin with.

Special abilities added with esoteric ritual count against the weapon’s limit of enhancements, but does not cost anything extra, so purchasing a +1 property for a +1 weapon still costs 6,000 gp, but the weapon counts as having a total +4 in the hands of the bloodstalker.

Sanguine Mastery (Su)

At 20th level, the total value of special abilities an s-class bloodstalker can add with esoteric ritual increases to +4, and his chosen weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus if it did not have one to start with. In addition, any attacks made with his chosen weapon automatically confirm all critical threats.
